title: Clone your cat in my game, BYOC
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I used an imagegen tool to generate textures that bake onto some breed models I have. The goal was to allow people to upload a few pics of their cats and get a decent representation of their cat into the game. 

Happy to share more on how this works if there are questions.

[catgame.io](http://catgame.io)

Give it a try and let me know if you have feedback! Still a early beta so there are some bugs to work out but overall it works most of the time 😹
